strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: april20268-kex991.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Credo entered a definitive agreement to acquire DustPhotonics, a developer of Silicon Photonics PIC technology for optical transceivers.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: The transaction is intended to expand Credo into silicon photonics and next-generation optical connectivity.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire DustPhotonics, a leading developer of Silicon Photonics Photonic Integrated Circuit (SiPho PIC) technology for optical transceivers.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: april20268-kex991.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: The acquisition is expected to position Credo with a vertically integrated connectivity stack spanning SerDes, DSP, Silicon Photonics, and system integration for AI infrastructure networks.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: Credo framed the transaction as a move toward end-to-end electrical and optical interconnect capabilities across scale-out and scale-up networks.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: The acquisition will position Credo with a vertically integrated connectivity stack spanning SerDes, Digital Signal Processing (DSP), Silicon Photonics and system integration for scale out and scale up networks — addressing both electrical and optical interconnects across the full AI infrastructure buildout.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: april20268-kex991.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Credo said DustPhotonics' SiPho PIC portfolio spans 400G, 800G, and 1.6T, with a roadmap to 3.2T, and can reduce component complexity, improve manufacturing yields, and lower cost at scale.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: The acquired technology is presented as improving product roadmap breadth and manufacturing economics as port speeds rise beyond 800G.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: DustPhotonics has developed a differentiated portfolio of SiPho PICs spanning 400G, 800G, and 1.6T, with a roadmap extending to 3.2T, that integrates key optical functions onto a single chip, reducing component complexity, improving manufacturing yields, and enabling meaningfully lower cost at scale as port speeds advance beyond 800G.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: april20268-kex991.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Credo stated DustPhotonics' SiPho PICs are deployed in transceivers at leading hyperscale AI clusters and are in design for NPO and CPO applications.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: The disclosure points to customer traction and relevance to hyperscale AI infrastructure and emerging optical architectures.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: These SiPho PICs are deployed in transceivers at leading hyperscale AI clusters and are also in design for leading Near Port Optics (NPO) and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) applications.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: april20268-kex991.htm

strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: The transaction rationale includes supply-chain control, faster roadmap execution, and potential margin/cost benefits.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: Bringing this capability in-house mitigates external supply dependencies, accelerates product development cycles, and creates a pathway to substantial cost structure improvement at volume.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.
